normalization.files: Preserve repo-relative source paths under vendor/<repo>. Root packages live at vendor/<repo>, not crate-root. Ancestor workspace manifests/notices retained as provenance; do not install unrelated donor workspace members.
normalization.manifests: Resolve inherited package metadata/lints/workspace dependencies to exact source values. Every retained own dependency points to one copied package identity. Keep registry declarations normal. Product lock comes from normalized graph, not donor lock.
normalization.config: Older otio Git egui-widgets-config83e2 intentionally unified onto approved copied96fc; record substitution and actual public consumer compatibility check.
normalization.inactive: nodes-chrome/exr-test-data are dev-only, wgpu-text3d optional engine-mesh3d. Their source records are conservative provenance, not active initial lib graph. Unresolved dev heif-transfer/wgpu-widgets/graph declarations must be excluded from initial retained test-pack manifest or physically closed before keeping them reachable; no own Git dependency remains silently in product lock.
normalization.bsdf: Default BSDF WGSL byte identity retained. cuda-math optional inactive: no CUDA source required for selected default/WASM library. Portable manifest explicitly defers/gates this native dependency/feature, or closes its physical own closure before retaining it reachable. No cache/private patch.
normalization.dialog: Native file-dialog filesystem package available; browser uses platform adapter, not unconditional native filesystem dependencies.

notices.preserve: Retain inventoried root/per-crate LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE and source comments exactly. Resolve declared workspace licenses; never substitute math_en license or invent missing text.

proof_limits: Exact committed source/hash/manifest/dependency/resource/notice inventory only; no builds/tests/product edits. Independent preflight review and executor normalized Cargo metadata/tree/check remain required.
